title: Apple, Cabbage and Mustard Seed Dumplings
subtitle: pan-fried and steamed potstickers
description: Spelt dumplings filled with cabbage, Granny Smith apple and wholegrain mustard, pan-fried and steamed in an apple cider vinegar sauce for a crisp base. Serve with a rocket salad and lemon.

steps.text: Make the dough: knead the spelt flour, water and salt for 4 to 5 minutes in a mixer (8 to 10 minutes by hand) until soft and pliable. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight.

Make the filling: heat the olive oil in a large pan, add the thinly sliced onion and fry for 3 to 4 minutes over low heat until lightly golden. Add the diced apples and stir. Add the sliced cabbage, za'atar leaves and 1 tsp pepper and saute for 7 to 8 minutes. Remove from the heat, stir in the mustard, cool, cover and refrigerate until filling.

Divide the dough into 3 equal parts and roll each into a long rope. Cut each rope into 10 equal pieces and roll each piece into a 1 mm thick circle, keeping the rest of the dough covered with a towel.
Place the circles on a tray lightly dusted with tapioca flour or cornflour. Put a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each and fold into a half moon.

Mix the apple cider vinegar, apple cider and water in a small bowl. Heat a heavy pan with olive oil, place the dumplings in it, sprinkle with za'atar leaves, chilli, sea salt and 0.5 tsp pepper and cover the pan. After 1 minute, remove the lid, pour in 2 to 3 tbsp of the sauce, swirl the pan, cover and steam-fry for 2 minutes.

Remove the lid, turn the dumplings, add 1 to 2 tbsp sauce, cover and cook for another 2 minutes until browned with a crisp coating. Repeat with the remaining dumplings (add a tablespoon of oil and 2 to 3 tbsp of sauce for each batch). Serve hot with a rocket salad and lemon.
